- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Evidence of fire pits in the caves suggests they may have used fire for cooking and warmth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The elaborate cave paintings may have had symbolic or spiritual significance, possibly used for rituals or ceremonies.
- [USER] User inquired about the tools prehistoric humans used to create the cave paintings in Altamira.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Prehistoric humans likely used animal-hair brushes, simple bone or wooden spatulas, and possibly their fingers or hands to create the paintings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pigments were obtained from natural sources and prepared by grinding them into powder and mixing with liquids like water, animal fat, or tree resin.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The intricate art demonstrates the high level of skill and creativity of prehistoric humans, using techniques like layering and shading.
